question: Why did the team reject reading package.json fresh on every incoming request instead of once at startup?
reference_answer: Reading the manifest per request was rejected because it introduces per-request file I/O and a per-request failure path to serve a value that only changes when the process restarts anyway.

gold.heading_path: 0001: Read the version once at module load with require('../package.json') > Alternatives
gold.quote: Introduces per-request file I/O and a per-request failure path (a 500 or a crash) to serve a value that only changes on restart anyway (intent Outcome 4).

question: Why does src/server.js throw at startup instead of just serving an empty object when package.json has no version field?
reference_answer: Serving {} or a null version when the field is missing was rejected because it would be silent and consequential: a stale or broken process would still look healthy.

gold.heading_path: 0002: Fail at module load when the manifest has no version string > Alternatives
gold.quote: Silent and consequential: a stale or wrong process looks like a healthy one.

question: Why did the operator override the risk classifier's tier-2 rating for the /version change at G1?
reference_answer: The operator overrode the tier to 1 because package.json is only read at runtime by this change and never modified, so the sensitive-path signal the classifier used to justify tier 2 does not actually apply.

gold.heading_path: Approvals: add GET /version endpoint returning package.json version > G1: approved
gold.quote: Tier overridden to 1 by the human: package.json is only read at runtime, never modified, so the sensitive-path signal does not apply. Intent approved.

question: Why didn't the eval designer just have the test rewrite the real package.json to prove the served version tracks it?
reference_answer: Rewriting the real package.json from inside a test was rejected because it writes a sensitive path from the suite, and a crash between the write and the restore would leave the repository modified.

gold.heading_path: 0003: Prove manifest tracking by spawning a temporary copy of the service > Alternatives
gold.quote: Writes a sensitive path from the suite; a crash between write and restore leaves the repository modified.
